swaps.retire_text: Assertion (A): A product labelled 'pure' on its packaging can still be impure in the scientific sense. Reason (R): the scientific meaning of pure substance requires that only one type of particle is present, which most everyday products do not satisfy.

add.q: Assertion (A): A product looks pure on its packaging, so it must consist of only one type of particle throughout. Reason (R): A pure substance, in the scientific sense, is one that has no other substance present in it and consists of the same type of particle throughout. Choose the correct option.
add.a: A is false, R is true
o: A is false, R is true
A is true, R is false
Both A and R are true, and R is the correct explanation of A
Both A and R are true, but R is not the correct explanation of A
